references.title: Dynamic harmonic regression
references.citation: 1999; Young, Pedregal, Tych; Journal of Forecasting 18(6),369–394
references.checked_scope: Abstract checked; state-space DHR, Kalman and fixed-interval smoothing, noise variance ratio selection.

references.title: Forecasting time series with complex seasonal patterns using exponential smoothing
references.citation: 2010 author working paper; published JASA 2011 DOI 10.1198/jasa.2011.tm09771
references.checked_scope: Sections 2.2–2.3, equations (3)–(4): damped trend and trigonometric states; zero seasonal smoothing gives deterministic seasonal pattern; single-source innovations differ from current independent Q.

references.title: bsts AddSemilocalLinearTrend
references.checked_scope: Description equations: level random walk plus slope; slope AR1 around D. D=0 with rescaled slope is current trend model.

references.title: bsts AddTrig
references.checked_scope: Details: direct sine/cosine state coefficients with random walk; harmonic rotating-state form; our static coefficients are zero-process-noise restriction.

references.title: statsmodels UnobservedComponents
references.checked_scope: Frequency-domain Seasonal equations and stochastic_freq_seasonal=False; no claim damped trend is built into default UCM.

references.title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice, dynamic harmonic regression
references.checked_scope: Fourier regression plus ARMA errors; adjacent family, not identical stochastic trend model.

references.title: Predicting the present with Bayesian structural time series
references.checked_scope: Bayesian structural states and spike-and-slab regression, posterior model averaging; differs from plug-in grid-selected noise parameters.

references.title: Forecasting at Scale
references.checked_scope: Fourier seasonality and modular regression predecessor, not identical damped stochastic trend.

references.title: Principles and algorithms for forecasting groups of time series: Locality and globality
references.checked_scope: Global/local learning precedent, not a claim of exact State-Fourier implementation.

references.title: Linear Dynamic Harmonic Regression official project page
references.checked_scope: University page confirms paper, GPL toolbox, and links to DHR1999.
